name: Wide Creator 4-4-2

slots.why: The sweeper keeper supports a higher engagement line and starts short combinations.
The support full-back overlaps selectively behind the defensive winger and keeps that flank secure.
A conventional defender anchors the back four; Cover is available for a quicker player.
The ball-playing defender can switch play toward the wide creator.
The attacking wing-back overlaps the playmaker, supplying the width the role deliberately gives up.
The defensive winger works back to protect the left and presses the opposition full-back, allowing the opposite flank to attack.
The defensive midfielder holds the centre and covers when the right-back overlaps.
The supporting midfielder links the central pair with the playmaker and forwards.
The wide playmaker drifts inside to create from the right, freeing the flank for the wing-back.
The deep-lying forward connects the wide creator with the runner beside him.
The advanced forward attacks the space created by the playmaker and overlapping wing-back.

description: A 4-4-2 with a defensive winger securing one flank and an attacking wide playmaker creating from the other, supported by an overlap and complementary forwards.
whyGood: It finds a role for a technical wide midfielder without exposing both flanks, and gives a fast striker runners to chase beyond the creator.
whyThisShape: The left side forms a defensive working unit, while the right side is deliberately overloaded: the playmaker comes inside, the wing-back overlaps, and the supporting striker offers a short connection. The central midfield pair keeps the asymmetry from becoming an open midfield.
whenToUse: When one of your best creators is a natural ML/MR rather than an attacking winger, and you have a tireless defensive wide player to balance him.
whenNotToUse: Against a side that can overload the space behind the attacking right-back, or if the wide playmaker lacks the technical quality to justify the imbalance.

instructionRationale.Fairly Wide: The defensive winger and attacking wing-back stretch the pitch around the creator.
instructionRationale.Slightly Shorter Passing: Keeps the ball close enough for the wide playmaker, support striker and midfield to combine.
instructionRationale.Work Ball Into Box: The playmaker waits for the overlap or forward movement instead of crossing speculatively.
instructionRationale.Overlap Right: The right-back supplies the outside run after the wide playmaker moves inside.
instructionRationale.Counter-Press: The defensive winger and central pair help recover the ball around the asymmetric flank.
instructionRationale.Higher Line of Engagement: Keeps the side close enough to sustain attacks around its creator.
instructionRationale.Standard Defensive Line: Retains cover behind the attacking full-back without requiring a risky high defensive line.
